title: Muraja'ah: Al-Mulk, Al-Qalam and Al-Haqqah 1 to 24: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 15. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Weak links in Al-Haqqah
points: 69:19 and 69:25 both start فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ
Say the next word aloud to fix it

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
older memorised portion on a rota

questions.q: Fix the weak link: recite 69:19 and 69:25 and explain how you remember the difference.
questions.a: 69:19 بِيَمِينِهِۦ then 'Here, read my record'; 69:25 بِشِمَالِهِۦ then 'I wish I had not been given my record'.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite today's manzil to a partner who marks the rubric (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 69:1 to 24 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric with scores and one target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: list your two weakest links in Al-Mulk or Al-Qalam.
questions.a: Pupil's own list with ayah numbers.

questions.q: Stretch: write a 5-day plan for your own manzil.
questions.a: A realistic plan logged in the portal.
A) بِيَمِينِهِۦ. 69:19: in his right hand. بِشِمَالِهِۦ is 69:25; وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ is from Al-Inshiqaq 84:10.

questions.q: The one given his record in his left hand says ...
questions.a: I wish I had not been given my record
options: I wish I had not been given my record

questions.q: Think again: Al-Mulk has 30 ayat, Al-Qalam 52, Al-Haqqah 52. How can you keep 134 ayat fresh at once?
questions.a: Divide them: sabaq daily, sabqi weekly, manzil on a rota, logged so nothing is left for too long.
